98.why: Passes split A/B. 'Largest' is ambiguous: the Nile is the longest river, the Amazon the largest by volume of water. School GK usually means the Nile; both readings are defensible.
98.reasoning: The Nile in Africa is the longest river in the world, about 6,650 km. The Amazon in South America carries the most water of any river, so it is the largest by volume. School books usually call the Nile the largest (longest) river.
98.notice: Two options can be right here: the Nile is the longest river in the world, and the Amazon carries the most water. In PYQ Vault mocks this question is awarded to every candidate.
